item.title: Antarctic ice caves used to save melting glacier fragments
item.description: The Ice Memory Foundation has inaugurated a unique preservation site in Antarctica to safeguard mountain ice cores that could otherwise disappear due to climate change. The facility is designed to store the samples for centuries under natural deep-freeze conditions, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Google and Meta strike AI chip deal
item.description: Meta Platforms Inc. has reportedly reached an agreement to lease artificial intelligence (AI) chips from Google LLC, according to information, citing a source familiar with the negotiations, AzerNEWS reports, citing foreign media.

item.title: Norway’s $2.2T sovereign wealth fund posts $248B gain last year on tech rally
item.description: Norway's sovereign wealth fund, the world’s largest, posted an annual profit of 2.36 trillion Norwegian kroner (about $248 billion) last year, delivering a 15.1% return as a rally in global stock markets boosted performance, according to the fund's financial results released Friday, AzerNEWS reports, citing Anadolu Agency.

item.title: Netflix drops plan to buy Warner Bros. assets
item.description: The American streaming giant Netflix has withdrawn from negotiations to acquire part of the assets of Hollywood media conglomerate Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD), effectively clearing the path for WBD’s potential merger with Paramount Skydance (PS), AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Former Airbus CEO calls Germany’s fighter jet partnership with France “strategic mistake”
item.description: Germany’s decision to develop its next-generation fighter aircraft with France rather than the United Kingdom has been described as a strategic error by former Airbus chief executive Tom Enders.

item.title: Instagram warn parents about suicidal signs
item.description: On Thursday, Meta announced that Instagram will begin warning parents if their child under the age of 16 frequently searches for images related to suicide or self-harm, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Azerbaijan moves to institutionalise AI as it seeks post-oil growth
item.description: A particularly strategic element of the Action Plan is the focus on “sovereign AI,” a concept gaining prominence globally. Sovereign AI refers to the capacity of a state to develop and operate AI systems using domestic infrastructure, data resources, and human capital, independent of foreign platforms. For Azerbaijan, this represents both an economic imperative and a matter of national security.

item.title: US to use AI to find China’s weaknesses
item.description: The Pentagon is reportedly developing artificial intelligence-based tools aimed at identifying vulnerabilities in Chinese infrastructure and potentially exploiting them in a future conflict, AzerNEWS reports, citing Financial Times.

item.title: Iran agrees not to retain enriched uranium, says Oman’s Foreign Minister
item.description: Iran has agreed not to keep enriched uranium on its territory that could be used to produce a nuclear weapon.

item.title: Italy and France lead imports of Azerbaijani frog meat
item.description: The figures highlight a niche but growing segment of Azerbaijan’s non-oil exports, particularly in agricultural and specialty food products aimed at European consumers.
